peg_li_spodumene_mine_concentrator.entity_type: Hard-rock lithium (LCT pegmatite) mine with co-located spodumene concentrator
peg_li_spodumene_mine_concentrator.definition: An open-pit or underground hard-rock mine on an LCT granitic pegmatite where lithium is hosted in spodumene, co-located with a beneficiation plant (DMS/flotation) that produces spodumene concentrate (SC6). Includes the in-situ orebody plus the attached concentrator.
peg_li_spodumene_mine_concentrator.main_function: Win spodumene ore from the pegmatite deposit and upgrade it to a ~6% Li2O spodumene concentrate (SC6).
peg_li_spodumene_mine_concentrator.qualification_criteria: Identifiable hard-rock mine on a spodumene-bearing LCT pegmatite with an attached/co-located concentrator producing ~6% Li2O spodumene concentrate.
peg_li_spodumene_mine_concentrator.exclusion_criteria: Non-spodumene lithium-mineral mines (petalite/mica/clay); standalone concentrators with no orebody; brine/geothermal/oilfield resources; tailings re-processing operations.

peg_li_pegmatite_mine_petalite.entity_type: Hard-rock LCT pegmatite mine (non-spodumene lithium host)
peg_li_pegmatite_mine_petalite.definition: A hard-rock mine working an in-situ LCT pegmatite orebody where lithium is hosted in petalite, amblygonite, or eucryptite rather than spodumene. Extracts and primary-crushes run-of-mine pegmatite ore.
peg_li_pegmatite_mine_petalite.main_function: Win lithium-bearing pegmatite ore from the deposit and deliver crushed run-of-mine ore.
peg_li_pegmatite_mine_petalite.qualification_criteria: Identifiable hard-rock mine on an LCT pegmatite hosting lithium in petalite/amblygonite/eucryptite; delivers crushed ROM ore for downstream beneficiation.
peg_li_pegmatite_mine_petalite.exclusion_criteria: Spodumene mines with integrated concentrators; lithium-mica or clay deposits; brine resources.

peg_li_pegmatite_concentrator.entity_type: Mineral beneficiation / concentrator plant (DMS, flotation, sensor sorting)
peg_li_pegmatite_concentrator.definition: A standalone concentrator that crushes, mills and physically separates lithium-pegmatite ore (petalite/amblygonite/eucryptite) into a lithium-mineral concentrate, rejecting silicate/mica gangue.
peg_li_pegmatite_concentrator.main_function: Upgrade run-of-mine pegmatite ore into a saleable lithium-mineral concentrate.
peg_li_pegmatite_concentrator.qualification_criteria: Physical beneficiation facility (DMS/flotation/sorting) producing a lithium-mineral concentrate from crushed pegmatite ore.
peg_li_pegmatite_concentrator.exclusion_criteria: Chemical conversion/roast-leach plants; mine-integrated spodumene concentrators already captured with their orebody; mica/clay-specific concentrators with distinct mineralogy.

peg_li_spodumene_sulfate_converter.entity_type: Lithium chemical conversion plant (calcination + sulfuric-acid roast + leach)
peg_li_spodumene_sulfate_converter.definition: A lithium chemical converter that receives spodumene concentrate and performs decrepitation calcining (alpha-to-beta), sulfuric-acid roasting and water leaching, with solution purification, to produce a purified lithium sulfate solution. Adjacent thermal, acid-roast and leach/purification stages occur within the same converter facility.
peg_li_spodumene_sulfate_converter.main_function: Convert spodumene concentrate into a purified lithium sulfate pregnant leach solution via calcine-roast-leach-purify.
peg_li_spodumene_sulfate_converter.qualification_criteria: Facility that calcines spodumene to beta phase, sulfates with H2SO4, water-leaches and purifies to a lithium sulfate solution.
peg_li_spodumene_sulfate_converter.exclusion_criteria: Alkaline soda-ash autoclave converters (no acid roast); mica/clay/jadarite roast-leach plants with distinct mineralogy/reagents; carbonate/hydroxide finishing plants.
source_candidate_names: Spodumene converter / lithium chemical plant (calcination and acid roast section)

peg_li_spodumene_sodaash_autoclave.entity_type: Lithium chemical conversion plant (alkaline pressure-leach autoclave)
peg_li_spodumene_sodaash_autoclave.definition: A lithium chemical converter using the alkaline soda-ash autoclave route: decrepitation calcining followed by sodium-carbonate pressure leach in an autoclave producing lithium carbonate directly (via lithium bicarbonate intermediate), leaving analcime residue. Materially different reactor set (pressure autoclaves, no acid roast kiln) than the sulfate converter.
peg_li_spodumene_sodaash_autoclave.main_function: Calcine spodumene and convert it directly to lithium carbonate by soda-ash pressure leaching and bicarbonate re-precipitation.
output_forms: Lithium carbonate (Li2CO3), technical and battery grade
peg_li_spodumene_sodaash_autoclave.qualification_criteria: Facility that calcines spodumene then performs sodium-carbonate autoclave pressure leaching to produce lithium carbonate without a sulfuric-acid roast.
peg_li_spodumene_sodaash_autoclave.exclusion_criteria: Sulfuric-acid roast-leach converters; standalone carbonate precipitation plants fed by purified solution; mica/clay conversion plants.

peg_li_carbonate_plant.group_name: Lithium carbonate precipitation and finishing plant
peg_li_carbonate_plant.definition: A lithium chemical converter that precipitates lithium carbonate from a purified lithium salt solution (sulfate or chloride) with soda ash and refines it via bicarbonation/re-precipitation, drying, milling and packaging to technical and battery grade. Reusable across brine and hard-rock feeds arriving as a purified lithium solution.
peg_li_carbonate_plant.main_function: Produce marketed technical- and battery-grade lithium carbonate from a purified lithium solution.
output_forms: Lithium carbonate (Li2CO3), technical and battery grade
peg_li_carbonate_plant.qualification_criteria: Chemical plant that precipitates and finishes lithium carbonate from a purified lithium salt solution with soda ash.
peg_li_carbonate_plant.exclusion_criteria: Hydroxide conversion plants; roast-leach/DLE upstream units; carbonate produced inside an autoclave converter (captured there).
source_candidate_names: Lithium chemical converter (carbonate precipitation and finishing section)

peg_li_hydroxide_causticization_plant.group_name: Lithium hydroxide causticization and crystallization plant
peg_li_hydroxide_causticization_plant.definition: A lithium chemical converter that turns a purified lithium feed (lithium carbonate via lime causticization, or lithium sulfate via NaOH causticization) into lithium hydroxide monohydrate, rejecting the calcium/sodium byproduct and crystallizing LiOH·H2O to technical and battery grade. Reusable wherever a carbonate or sulfate feed is upgraded to hydroxide.
peg_li_hydroxide_causticization_plant.main_function: Convert a purified lithium feed into technical- or battery-grade lithium hydroxide monohydrate by causticization and evaporative crystallization.
output_forms: Lithium hydroxide monohydrate (LiOH·H2O), technical and battery grade
peg_li_hydroxide_causticization_plant.qualification_criteria: Chemical plant that causticizes a lithium carbonate or lithium sulfate feed to lithium hydroxide and crystallizes LiOH·H2O.
peg_li_hydroxide_causticization_plant.exclusion_criteria: Electrochemical (bipolar-membrane/chlor-alkali) hydroxide plants; carbonate precipitation plants; roast-leach units.
source_candidate_names: Lithium hydroxide converter (causticization and crystallization section)

peg_li_hydroxide_electrochemical_plant.entity_type: Electrochemical lithium hydroxide plant (bipolar-membrane electrodialysis / chlor-alkali membrane electrolysis)
peg_li_hydroxide_electrochemical_plant.definition: An electrochemical lithium-hydroxide converter that splits a purified lithium salt feed (lithium sulfate or lithium chloride) directly into lithium hydroxide plus a co-product acid (sulfuric acid, or HCl/Cl2/H2) via bipolar-membrane electrodialysis or chlor-alkali-type membrane electrolysis, then crystallizes LiOH·H2O. Distinct facility type (membrane stacks/rectifiers) from the causticization plant.
peg_li_hydroxide_electrochemical_plant.main_function: Electrochemically convert a purified lithium salt into battery-grade lithium hydroxide monohydrate, co-producing recyclable acid.
peg_li_hydroxide_electrochemical_plant.qualification_criteria: Chemical/electrochemical plant that converts a purified lithium sulfate or chloride feed to LiOH by bipolar-membrane electrodialysis or membrane electrolysis and crystallizes LiOH·H2O.
peg_li_hydroxide_electrochemical_plant.exclusion_criteria: Lime/NaOH causticization plants (reactor-precipitator, not electrolyzer); carbonate plants; molten-salt metal electrolysis works.
source_candidate_names: Electrochemical lithium hydroxide converter (membrane electrolysis plant)
Lithium chloride electrolysis (membrane / chlor-alkali) hydroxide plant

peg_li_anhydrous_licl_plant.entity_type: Lithium chloride conversion / crystallization / drying plant (electrolysis-feed grade)
peg_li_anhydrous_licl_plant.definition: A chemical plant that converts a lithium chemical (carbonate or hydroxide) or a purified LiCl liquor into purified anhydrous lithium chloride crystals via HCl/chlorination reaction and dehydration/drying, for use as molten-salt electrolysis feedstock. Reusable across brine-derived, hard-rock-derived and recycled LiCl feeds.
peg_li_anhydrous_licl_plant.main_function: Produce electrolysis-grade anhydrous lithium chloride feedstock.
peg_li_anhydrous_licl_plant.qualification_criteria: Chemical plant that produces dry, high-purity anhydrous LiCl suitable for molten-salt electrolysis from a carbonate/hydroxide/LiCl feed.
peg_li_anhydrous_licl_plant.exclusion_criteria: LiCl purification/concentration units that do not dehydrate to anhydrous salt; molten-salt metal electrolysis works; hydroxide conversion plants.
source_candidate_names: Lithium chloride purification, concentration & drying unit

peg_li_metal_electrolysis_works.group_name: Molten-salt lithium metal electrowinning and refining works
peg_li_metal_electrolysis_works.entity_type: Molten-salt (fused-salt / Downs-type) lithium electrolysis and metal refinery
peg_li_metal_electrolysis_works.definition: A high-temperature electrometallurgical works operating molten-salt (LiCl-KCl eutectic) electrolytic cells that reduce anhydrous lithium chloride to metallic lithium, with chlorine handling, casting, refining and inert-atmosphere finishing to ingot/foil/granular product. Reusable across any anhydrous-LiCl feed source.
peg_li_metal_electrolysis_works.main_function: Electrowin, refine and cast metallic lithium from anhydrous lithium chloride.
peg_li_metal_electrolysis_works.qualification_criteria: Electrometallurgical facility performing molten-salt electrolysis of anhydrous LiCl to metallic lithium with casting/refining.
peg_li_metal_electrolysis_works.exclusion_criteria: Membrane/chlor-alkali hydroxide electrolysis plants; anhydrous-LiCl preparation plants; carbonate/hydroxide converters.
source_candidate_names: Lithium metal electrowinning / molten-salt electrolysis plant

peg_li_mica_mine.definition: An in-situ deposit and mining operation where lithium is hosted in lithium-mica minerals (lepidolite, zinnwaldite) within granite, pegmatite or greisen; often companion to Sn-W/Cs/Rb/Ta systems. Produces run-of-mine lithium-mica ore.
peg_li_mica_mine.main_function: Win lithium-mica orebody and produce run-of-mine lithium-mica ore.
peg_li_mica_mine.qualification_criteria: Identifiable hard-rock mine where lithium is hosted in lithium-mica (lepidolite/zinnwaldite) minerals; delivers ROM mica ore.
peg_li_mica_mine.exclusion_criteria: Spodumene/petalite pegmatite mines; clay/jadarite deposits; brine resources.

peg_li_mica_concentrator.entity_type: Mineral beneficiation / flotation & magnetic separation plant
peg_li_mica_concentrator.definition: A facility that comminutes lithium-mica ore and upgrades it into a lithium-mica (lepidolite/zinnwaldite) concentrate via flotation and/or magnetic separation, rejecting quartz/feldspar gangue. Magnetic separation is favored for Fe-rich paramagnetic zinnwaldite. Often co-located with the mine.
peg_li_mica_concentrator.main_function: Upgrade lithium-mica ore into a saleable/roast-ready lithium-mica concentrate.
peg_li_mica_concentrator.qualification_criteria: Physical beneficiation facility using flotation and/or magnetic separation to upgrade lithium-mica ore to concentrate.

peg_li_mica_sulfate_roast_leach.entity_type: Pyrometallurgical sulfate-salt roast + hydrometallurgical leach plant
peg_li_mica_sulfate_roast_leach.definition: A chemical plant that mixes lithium-mica concentrate with sulfate roasting reagents (Na2SO4/CaSO4/K2SO4), roasts to convert refractory lattice lithium to water-soluble lithium sulfate, then water-leaches to a lithium sulfate pregnant solution. Distinct from spodumene acid roasting due to mica mineralogy and high F/Rb/Cs load.
peg_li_mica_sulfate_roast_leach.main_function: Liberate lithium from the mica lattice into a lithium sulfate pregnant leach solution via sulfate-salt roasting.
peg_li_mica_sulfate_roast_leach.qualification_criteria: Chemical plant that sulfate-salt roasts and water-leaches lithium-mica concentrate to a lithium sulfate solution.
peg_li_mica_sulfate_roast_leach.exclusion_criteria: Lime-sulfate (limestone/gypsum) mica roast plants; spodumene acid roast-leach; clay/jadarite leach plants.

peg_li_mica_lime_sulfate_roast_leach.definition: A chemical plant that roasts lithium-mica/zinnwaldite concentrate with limestone and gypsum (plus recycled sodium sulfate) to convert lattice lithium to water-soluble lithium(-potassium) sulfate, then water-leaches to a pregnant solution. Materially distinct reagent chemistry from the pure sulfate-salt roast; characteristic of the Cinovec/Zinnwald flowsheet.
peg_li_mica_lime_sulfate_roast_leach.main_function: Liberate lithium from zinnwaldite/mica lattice via lime-sulfate roasting into a lithium sulfate solution.
peg_li_mica_lime_sulfate_roast_leach.qualification_criteria: Chemical plant that roasts mica concentrate with limestone/gypsum and water-leaches to a lithium sulfate solution.
peg_li_mica_lime_sulfate_roast_leach.exclusion_criteria: Sulfate-salt-only mica roast plants; spodumene/clay/jadarite conversion plants.

peg_li_sulfate_solution_purification.definition: A purification circuit within a lithium chemical plant that removes Fe/Al/Mg/Ca/Mn (and, for mica feeds, fluoride and Rb/Cs) from a lithium sulfate pregnant liquor by precipitation and ion exchange, delivering a battery-precursor-grade purified lithium sulfate liquor.
peg_li_sulfate_solution_purification.main_function: Purify a lithium sulfate pregnant liquor to chemical-conversion feed quality.
peg_li_sulfate_solution_purification.qualification_criteria: Hydrometallurgical circuit removing Fe/Al/Mg/Ca (and F/Rb/Cs where present) from a lithium sulfate liquor to conversion grade.
peg_li_sulfate_solution_purification.exclusion_criteria: Roast-leach plants that produce the pregnant liquor; brine softening/DLE units; carbonate/hydroxide finishing plants.

peg_li_salar_brine_wellfield.entity_type: Salar brine well-field (closed-basin lithium brine extraction operation)
peg_li_salar_brine_wellfield.definition: A salar-based operation that extracts dissolved-Li+ continental brine from a closed-basin aquifer via a well-field and delivers raw brine to concentration. The in-situ reservoir is the anchored origin and the well-field is the first route position.
peg_li_salar_brine_wellfield.main_function: Pump and deliver raw lithium-bearing brine from the salar aquifer.
input_forms: In-situ salar brine (dissolved Li+, ~200-2000+ mg/L Li)
peg_li_salar_brine_wellfield.qualification_criteria: Closed-basin salar operation with a well-field extracting dissolved-Li+ continental brine to surface.
peg_li_salar_brine_wellfield.exclusion_criteria: Geothermal brine fields (co-produced with power); oilfield/produced-water brine formations; hard-rock/clay deposits.
source_candidate_names: Continental brine well-field / salar extraction operator

peg_li_solar_evaporation_ponds.entity_type: Solar evaporation pond field / salar brine concentration plant
peg_li_solar_evaporation_ponds.definition: An engineered pond field on the salar that concentrates raw brine by solar/wind evaporation and fractionally precipitates bulk salts (halite, sylvinite, carnallite, bischofite), yielding a high-lithium concentrated liquor plus potash/boron/magnesium co-product streams.
peg_li_solar_evaporation_ponds.main_function: Solar-concentrate brine and reject bulk co-product salts to produce a high-Li liquor.
output_forms: Concentrated lithium liquor (~4-6% Li, LiCl/mixed-chloride brine)
peg_li_solar_evaporation_ponds.qualification_criteria: Engineered evaporation pond field that concentrates salar brine and precipitates bulk salts to a high-Li liquor.
peg_li_solar_evaporation_ponds.exclusion_criteria: DLE plants; brine softening/purification units; geothermal/oilfield brine pretreatment.
source_candidate_names: Solar evaporation pond concentrator (salar brine operator)

peg_li_brine_softening_unit.entity_type: Brine purification (softening / boron & Mg removal) plant
peg_li_brine_softening_unit.definition: A purification section, usually co-located with the lithium chemical plant, that softens and de-borons concentrated brine liquor (removing Mg/Ca/B/SO4) to produce a clean lithium feed. Reusable across carbonate, hydroxide and metal brine routes.
peg_li_brine_softening_unit.main_function: Remove Mg/Ca/B/SO4 impurities from concentrated brine to a chemical-grade lithium feed.
input_forms: Concentrated lithium liquor (~4-6% Li, mixed-chloride brine)
peg_li_brine_softening_unit.qualification_criteria: Brine softening/de-boronation unit producing a purified lithium liquor from evaporatively concentrated brine.
peg_li_brine_softening_unit.exclusion_criteria: Solar evaporation ponds; DLE plants; LiCl eluate concentration/purification units; sulfate-liquor purification circuits for mineral feeds.

peg_li_dle_plant.entity_type: DLE plant (adsorption / ion-exchange / solvent-extraction lithium recovery)
peg_li_dle_plant.definition: An engineered plant that selectively captures Li+ from raw or pretreated brine using DLE media (sorbent adsorption, ion exchange, or solvent extraction) and elutes it as a dilute lithium chloride stream, rejecting Mg/Ca/Na/B to spent brine, in place of solar evaporation ponds. Reusable across salar, geothermal and oilfield brine sources.
peg_li_dle_plant.main_function: Selectively recover lithium from brine as a dilute LiCl eluate and reject barren brine.
peg_li_dle_plant.qualification_criteria: Plant that selectively extracts lithium from brine via sorption/IX/SX and produces a dilute LiCl eluate without evaporation ponds.
peg_li_dle_plant.exclusion_criteria: Solar evaporation ponds; LiCl concentration/purification units; brine pretreatment (silica/iron removal) units.
source_candidate_names: Direct Lithium Extraction (DLE) & Lithium Chloride Concentration Plant

peg_li_licl_concentration_purification.group_name: Lithium chloride eluate concentration & purification unit
peg_li_licl_concentration_purification.definition: A unit that upgrades a dilute DLE-derived LiCl eluate into a purified, concentrated lithium chloride liquor by softening, ion exchange (Ca/Mg/B removal) and membrane/thermal concentration. Often integrated with the DLE plant or downstream converter; reusable across DLE-based carbonate, hydroxide and metal routes.
peg_li_licl_concentration_purification.main_function: Concentrate and purify DLE eluate to a chemical-grade lithium chloride liquor.
peg_li_licl_concentration_purification.qualification_criteria: Unit that softens, IX-polishes and concentrates a dilute LiCl eluate to a purified concentrated LiCl liquor.
peg_li_licl_concentration_purification.exclusion_criteria: DLE capture plants; anhydrous-LiCl drying plants; brine softening of evaporated salar liquor; carbonate/hydroxide converters.

peg_li_brine_concentration_composite.entity_type: Brine concentration / lithium chloride purification plant (composite)
peg_li_brine_concentration_composite.definition: A composite concentration-and-purification capability that delivers a purified LiCl liquor from raw brine, realized either as a solar-pond concentrator + softening unit or a DLE + LiCl-purification train. Used where a downstream metal route requires only a purified LiCl liquor and either front-end can supply it.
peg_li_brine_concentration_composite.main_function: Concentrate and purify raw brine to a purified lithium chloride liquor.
peg_li_brine_concentration_composite.qualification_criteria: Composite front-end that concentrates and purifies brine to a purified LiCl liquor via either pond+softening or DLE+purification.
peg_li_brine_concentration_composite.exclusion_criteria: Standalone realizations already captured as separate pond/DLE/purification groups where the flowsheet is specific.
source_candidate_names: Brine concentration & LiCl purification (pond concentrator + purification, or DLE + LiCl unit)

peg_li_geothermal_brine_field.group_name: Geothermal brine field with co-located power plant
peg_li_geothermal_brine_field.entity_type: Geothermal brine reservoir with co-located geothermal power plant and production/reinjection wellfield
peg_li_geothermal_brine_field.definition: A deep high-temperature geothermal reservoir and its wellfield plus co-located geothermal power plant that produces Li-bearing brine, extracts heat/power, and delivers hot spent brine to lithium recovery; reinjects depleted brine. Anchored at the reservoir origin.
peg_li_geothermal_brine_field.main_function: Produce Li-bearing geothermal fluid, extract energy, and supply lithium-bearing spent brine feedstock.
input_forms: Deep hot subsurface geothermal reservoir (dissolved Li+ in high-temperature saline brine)
peg_li_geothermal_brine_field.qualification_criteria: Deep geothermal reservoir + wellfield + co-located power plant producing Li-bearing spent brine.
peg_li_geothermal_brine_field.exclusion_criteria: Continental salar brine well-fields; oilfield/produced-water formations; hard-rock/clay deposits.

peg_li_geothermal_brine_pretreatment.definition: A facility that oxidizes and pH-adjusts hot geothermal spent brine to co-precipitate silica, iron and manganese, producing a clarified Li-bearing brine suitable for DLE. Distinctive to high-silica/iron geothermal brine versus continental salar brine.
peg_li_geothermal_brine_pretreatment.main_function: Remove silica/iron/Mn and scaling species from geothermal brine ahead of lithium extraction.
peg_li_geothermal_brine_pretreatment.qualification_criteria: Plant that conditions hot geothermal brine to remove silica/iron/Mn ahead of DLE.
peg_li_geothermal_brine_pretreatment.exclusion_criteria: Salar brine softening units; DLE capture plants; oilfield produced-water de-oiling facilities.

peg_li_oilfield_brine_formation.entity_type: Hydrocarbon-associated subsurface brine formation (companion/byproduct Li resource)
peg_li_oilfield_brine_formation.definition: A subsurface hydrocarbon-bearing sedimentary formation whose connate/formation brine carries dissolved lithium, co-produced with oil & gas as produced water or accessed via brine supply wells (e.g., Smackover Formation, Marcellus Shale). Distinct from continental salar and geothermal brine host systems.
peg_li_oilfield_brine_formation.main_function: Host and yield lithium-bearing formation brine to surface as origin feedstock for a produced-water/DLE recovery route.
input_forms: (origin) subsurface hydrocarbon formation with connate Li-bearing brine
output_forms: Lithium-bearing oilfield formation / produced-water brine (dissolved Li+)
peg_li_oilfield_brine_formation.qualification_criteria: Hydrocarbon-associated subsurface formation whose connate/produced brine carries recoverable dissolved lithium.
peg_li_oilfield_brine_formation.exclusion_criteria: Salar and geothermal brine resources; hard-rock/clay deposits.
source_candidate_names: Oilfield / petroleum-formation lithium brine resource site

peg_li_producedwater_pretreatment.definition: A surface facility with production/supply and injection wells plus a pretreatment train that de-oils, de-solids and conditions co-produced formation brine so it can feed a DLE unit, including UIC reinjection of barren brine.
peg_li_producedwater_pretreatment.main_function: Deliver conditioned, impurity-reduced lithium brine to the DLE unit and reinject lithium-depleted brine.
input_forms: Lithium-bearing oilfield formation / produced-water brine (raw, with hydrocarbons and solids)
peg_li_producedwater_pretreatment.qualification_criteria: Surface wellfield + pretreatment facility that de-oils/de-solids produced brine to a DLE feed and reinjects barren brine.
peg_li_producedwater_pretreatment.exclusion_criteria: Geothermal silica/iron removal plants; DLE capture plants; salar pond/softening operations.

peg_li_clay_mine.definition: An open-pit mine working a volcano-sedimentary lithium claystone (smectite/hectorite + Li-illite) deposit hosted in caldera-lake sediments, producing run-of-mine clay ore.
peg_li_clay_mine.main_function: Win lithium-bearing claystone ore from the in-situ deposit and deliver crushed/screened clay ore.
input_forms: In-situ lithium claystone deposit (smectite/hectorite + Li-illite host)
peg_li_clay_mine.qualification_criteria: Open-pit mine on a volcano-sedimentary lithium claystone deposit delivering ROM clay ore.
peg_li_clay_mine.exclusion_criteria: Hard-rock pegmatite/mica mines; jadarite-borate mines; brine resources.

peg_li_clay_beneficiation.definition: A physical beneficiation facility that scrubs and classifies lithium claystone to concentrate the fine Li-bearing clay fraction and reject acid-consuming coarse gangue, raising leach head grade.
peg_li_clay_beneficiation.main_function: Upgrade clay ore into a higher-grade, lower-mass lithium clay concentrate suitable for leaching.
output_forms: Upgraded lithium clay concentrate (deslimed fine clay fraction)
peg_li_clay_beneficiation.qualification_criteria: Attrition-scrubbing/classification facility concentrating the Li-bearing fine clay fraction of claystone.
peg_li_clay_beneficiation.exclusion_criteria: Pegmatite/mica flotation concentrators; chemical leach plants; salt-roast calcination plants.

peg_li_clay_acid_leach.group_name: Lithium clay sulfuric-acid leach & neutralization plant
peg_li_clay_acid_leach.entity_type: Hydrometallurgical acid-leach plant (with captive acid plant)
peg_li_clay_acid_leach.definition: A hydrometallurgical facility that leaches lithium from clay concentrate with sulfuric acid (often with a captive sulfur-burning acid plant), neutralizes the pregnant slurry, and (in the integrated variant) clarifies and purifies to a lithium sulfate solution.
peg_li_clay_acid_leach.main_function: Convert solid lithium clay into a pregnant/purified lithium sulfate leach solution.
output_forms: Pregnant lithium sulfate (Li2SO4) leach slurry (partially neutralized)
peg_li_clay_acid_leach.qualification_criteria: Hydrometallurgical plant that sulfuric-acid leaches lithium clay concentrate to a lithium sulfate pregnant/purified solution.
peg_li_clay_acid_leach.exclusion_criteria: HCl chloride-leach clay plants; salt-roast clay calcination plants; spodumene/mica roast-leach; carbonate/hydroxide finishing plants.
source_candidate_names: Clay acid-leach & neutralization plant (with captive acid plant)

peg_li_clay_hcl_leach.definition: A hydrometallurgical facility that leaches lithium from clay concentrate with hydrochloric acid, producing a lithium chloride pregnant liquor; distinct reagent/chloride circuit and materials of construction versus the sulfate leach route.
peg_li_clay_hcl_leach.main_function: Convert lithium clay into a pregnant lithium chloride leach solution.
peg_li_clay_hcl_leach.qualification_criteria: Hydrometallurgical plant that HCl-leaches lithium clay concentrate to a lithium chloride pregnant liquor.
peg_li_clay_hcl_leach.exclusion_criteria: Sulfuric-acid clay leach plants; salt-roast calcination; anhydrous-LiCl conversion plants.

peg_li_clay_salt_roast.definition: A pyrometallurgical roasting facility that calcines lithium clay with chloride/sulfate salt additives (NaCl, Na2SO4, KCl, gypsum) at high temperature to convert lattice-bound lithium into water-soluble lithium salts, breaking the clay structure thermally rather than with acid.
peg_li_clay_salt_roast.main_function: Thermally convert clay-bound lithium into water-leachable lithium salts.
output_forms: Roasted calcine bearing water-soluble lithium salts
peg_li_clay_salt_roast.qualification_criteria: Pyrometallurgical roasting plant that salt-roasts lithium clay to produce a water-soluble lithium-salt calcine.
peg_li_clay_salt_roast.exclusion_criteria: Acid-leach clay plants; water-leach circuits; spodumene/mica roast-leach.

peg_li_water_leach_separation.definition: A water-leaching and clarification circuit that dissolves water-soluble lithium salts from a roasted calcine into a low-impurity aqueous liquor and separates gangue residue.
peg_li_water_leach_separation.main_function: Produce a clarified lithium-bearing leach solution from roasted calcine.
input_forms: Roasted calcine bearing water-soluble lithium salts
peg_li_water_leach_separation.qualification_criteria: Water-leach + clarification circuit dissolving lithium salts from a roasted calcine.
peg_li_water_leach_separation.exclusion_criteria: Acid-leach plants; roasting/calcination plants; solution purification circuits.

peg_li_clay_ccd_filtration.definition: A thickening, counter-current decantation (CCD) and filtration circuit that clarifies a pregnant leach slurry and manages leached-clay residue as filtered tailings.
peg_li_clay_ccd_filtration.main_function: Separate clarified pregnant lithium solution from spent clay residue.
peg_li_clay_ccd_filtration.qualification_criteria: CCD/filtration circuit clarifying a pregnant leach slurry and filtering clay tailings.
peg_li_clay_ccd_filtration.exclusion_criteria: Chemical purification (impurity precipitation/IX) circuits; leach reactors; carbonate finishing.

peg_li_generic_solution_purification.definition: A chemical purification circuit that removes Mg, Ca, Al, Fe, Mn, B and other impurities from a clarified lithium-bearing solution (sulfate or chloride) ahead of lithium-salt precipitation, delivering a battery-grade-precursor liquor. Applied to clay/salt-roast leach liquors.
peg_li_generic_solution_purification.main_function: Deliver a high-purity lithium salt solution meeting battery-grade impurity limits.
output_forms: Purified lithium salt solution (sulfate or chloride)
peg_li_generic_solution_purification.qualification_criteria: Chemical impurity-removal circuit polishing a clarified lithium leach solution to battery-grade-precursor quality.
peg_li_generic_solution_purification.exclusion_criteria: Leach reactors; CCD/filtration; brine softening of evaporated salar liquor; carbonate/hydroxide finishing plants.

peg_li_jadarite_mine.definition: An underground mining operation exploiting a jadarite-hosted lacustrine volcano-sedimentary Li-B deposit (Jadar-type). Reusable host-type category; presently unique to the Jadar Valley, Serbia.
peg_li_jadarite_mine.main_function: Win run-of-mine jadarite ore from the in-situ deposit and deliver it to surface for beneficiation.
input_forms: In-situ jadarite ore (LiNaSiB3O7(OH) in volcano-sedimentary host)
peg_li_jadarite_mine.qualification_criteria: Underground mine on a jadarite-hosted volcano-sedimentary Li-B deposit delivering ROM jadarite ore.

peg_li_jadarite_beneficiation.definition: A surface mineral-processing facility that crushes, grinds (HPGR) and size-classifies ROM jadarite ore into a leach-grade jadarite concentrate, rejecting fines as beneficiation residue. Normally co-located with the mine.
peg_li_jadarite_beneficiation.main_function: Upgrade ROM jadarite ore into a leach-grade jadarite concentrate.
peg_li_jadarite_beneficiation.qualification_criteria: HPGR-based comminution/beneficiation plant producing jadarite concentrate from ROM ore.

peg_li_jadarite_acid_leach.definition: A hydrometallurgical facility that leaches jadarite concentrate with sulphuric acid to liberate Li, B and Na into a pregnant leach solution, filtering out digestion residue. First hydromet unit of the integrated Jadar chemical plant.
peg_li_jadarite_acid_leach.main_function: Convert solid jadarite concentrate into a lithium-, boron- and sodium-bearing pregnant leach solution.
output_forms: Pregnant leach solution (PLS: Li/B/Na sulphate liquor)
peg_li_jadarite_acid_leach.qualification_criteria: Sulphuric-acid digestion plant producing a Li/B/Na PLS from jadarite concentrate.
peg_li_jadarite_acid_leach.exclusion_criteria: Boron-removal and liquor-purification units; spodumene/clay leach plants; carbonate finishing.

peg_li_boron_recovery_unit.group_name: Boric acid recovery / boron removal unit
peg_li_boron_recovery_unit.entity_type: Boric acid crystallisation / boron co-product recovery unit
peg_li_boron_recovery_unit.definition: A hydrometallurgical unit within the integrated Jadar chemical plant that removes boron from the pregnant leach solution and crystallises it as boric acid co-product, yielding a boron-depleted lithium liquor. Distinctive of Li-B co-product Jadar-type processing.
peg_li_boron_recovery_unit.main_function: Recover boron as boric acid and purify the liquor of boron ahead of lithium precipitation.
peg_li_boron_recovery_unit.qualification_criteria: Unit that removes and crystallises boron as boric acid from a Li/B PLS.
peg_li_boron_recovery_unit.exclusion_criteria: Sodium-sulphate/liming purification units; acid-leach digestion; carbonate precipitation.

peg_li_liquor_purification_na2so4.main_function: Purify the lithium liquor and remove sodium as sodium sulphate co-product.
peg_li_liquor_purification_na2so4.qualification_criteria: Liming/purification + Na2SO4 crystallisation unit delivering a purified lithium sulphate liquor.
peg_li_liquor_purification_na2so4.exclusion_criteria: Boron-recovery units; acid-leach digestion; carbonate precipitation plants.
source_candidate_names: Liquor Purification & Sodium Sulphate Crystallisation Unit

peg_li_tailings_reflotation.entity_type: Standalone tailings/residue accumulation worked directly with on-site re-concentration
peg_li_tailings_reflotation.definition: A legacy lithium-bearing tailings pile or process-residue dump worked directly as a standalone lithium source, with reclamation and re-flotation to upgrade residual spodumene into a concentrate. No active upstream mine feeds it.
peg_li_tailings_reflotation.main_function: Reclaim legacy Li tailings and upgrade residual spodumene into a flotation concentrate.
input_forms: Lithium-bearing tailings / residue (residual Li in spodumene flotation tailings, low-grade bulk)
peg_li_tailings_reflotation.qualification_criteria: Standalone legacy tailings accumulation worked directly with on-site re-flotation to a spodumene concentrate.
peg_li_tailings_reflotation.exclusion_criteria: Active mines; direct-leach tailings operators (no re-flotation); spent-battery accumulations.

peg_li_tailings_directleach.entity_type: Standalone tailings/residue accumulation worked directly with on-site direct leaching
peg_li_tailings_directleach.definition: A legacy lithium tailings/residue accumulation worked directly as a standalone source, where the bulk low-grade residue is reclaimed and directly acid-leached (with optional activation roast) rather than re-floated.
peg_li_tailings_directleach.main_function: Reclaim legacy Li tailings and extract lithium directly into a pregnant leach solution.
input_forms: Lithium-bearing tailings / residue (residual Li in spodumene flotation tailings, low-grade bulk)
output_forms: Lithium pregnant leach solution (impure; sulfate or phosphate/sulfate)
peg_li_tailings_directleach.qualification_criteria: Standalone legacy tailings accumulation worked directly by direct acid leaching to a pregnant solution.
peg_li_tailings_directleach.exclusion_criteria: Re-flotation tailings operators; active mines; spent-battery accumulations.

peg_li_battery_collection_site.entity_type: End-of-life / recycled accumulation (collection, sorting & discharge yard)
peg_li_battery_collection_site.definition: An aggregation and pre-treatment site where post-consumer and post-industrial spent lithium-ion batteries and manufacturing scrap are collected, sorted, discharged and dismantled (or prepared as smelter feed) into a safe feedstock. The anchored original host accumulation for the secondary (recycled) lithium source.
peg_li_battery_collection_site.main_function: Accumulate, sort, safely discharge and dismantle/prepare EOL batteries/scrap into a de-energized feedstock stream.
input_forms: Spent lithium-ion batteries / manufacturing scrap (lithium hosted in cathode active material)
output_forms: Discharged, sorted, dismantled spent cells / electrode scrap (feedstock for shredding)
Sorted spent batteries / scrap prepared as smelter feed
peg_li_battery_collection_site.qualification_criteria: Collection/deactivation yard aggregating and preparing EOL lithium batteries/scrap as recycling feedstock.
peg_li_battery_collection_site.exclusion_criteria: Shredding/black-mass plants; smelters; hydromet refineries; primary resource sites.

peg_li_black_mass_plant.group_name: Battery shredding & black mass production plant
peg_li_black_mass_plant.entity_type: Mechanical / thermal battery pre-processing (shredder + black-mass) facility
peg_li_black_mass_plant.definition: A facility that mechanically shreds discharged spent cells/scrap, applies thermal pretreatment/pyrolysis, and physically separates the fraction into black mass plus recovered casings, foils and plastics. Black mass is a route intermediate downstream of the anchored EOL accumulation.
peg_li_black_mass_plant.main_function: Produce concentrated black mass (metal-oxide + graphite powder) and segregate housing/foil/plastic side-streams.
input_forms: Discharged, sorted, dismantled spent cells / electrode scrap
output_forms: Recovered steel, aluminium, copper, plastics side-streams
peg_li_black_mass_plant.qualification_criteria: Mechanical/thermal pre-processing plant producing black mass and segregated side-streams from spent cells.
peg_li_black_mass_plant.exclusion_criteria: Pyrometallurgical smelters; hydromet leach refineries; collection yards.
source_candidate_names: Battery Shredding & Black Mass Production Plant

peg_li_blackmass_hydromet_refinery.definition: A hydrometallurgical plant that leaches black mass into solution and removes impurities (Cu, Fe, Al, graphite) to produce a purified pregnant leach liquor containing Li, Ni, Co, Mn.
peg_li_blackmass_hydromet_refinery.main_function: Convert solid black mass into a purified metal-bearing leachate.
output_forms: Purified metal-bearing leach liquor (Li + Ni/Co/Mn in solution)
peg_li_blackmass_hydromet_refinery.qualification_criteria: Hydromet plant that leaches black mass and removes impurities to a purified metal-bearing liquor.
peg_li_blackmass_hydromet_refinery.exclusion_criteria: Metal-separation/SX lithium-salt plants (downstream); black-mass mechanical plants; smelters; slag-leach plants.

peg_li_battery_metals_separation.group_name: Battery-metals separation & recycled lithium chemical plant
peg_li_battery_metals_separation.definition: The section of a hydrometallurgical battery-metals refinery that separates Ni/Co/Mn from the leachate (solvent extraction) and recovers lithium from the raffinate as a lithium salt (carbonate or sulfate) via precipitation/crystallization. Reusable lithium-chemical converter category for recycled feed.

input_forms: Purified metal-bearing leach liquor (Li + Ni/Co/Mn in solution)
output_forms: Lithium carbonate (Li2CO3), technical and battery grade
Ni/Co/Mn sulfates or mixed hydroxide precursor (co-products)
peg_li_battery_metals_separation.qualification_criteria: SX/crystallization plant that separates Ni/Co/Mn and recovers a lithium salt from black-mass leachate.
peg_li_battery_metals_separation.exclusion_criteria: Leach/impurity-removal section (upstream); primary-feed carbonate plants; hydroxide/LiCl converters.

peg_li_hydroxide_bmed_recycle.group_name: Recycled lithium hydroxide conversion & crystallization plant
peg_li_hydroxide_bmed_recycle.definition: A plant that converts a recovered lithium salt (lithium sulfate via bipolar-membrane electrodialysis, or lithium carbonate via lime causticization) into lithium hydroxide and crystallizes LiOH·H2O to technical and battery grade. Reusable lithium-hydroxide converter for recycled feeds; may be co-located with the SX/lithium-salt plant.
peg_li_hydroxide_bmed_recycle.main_function: Produce and crystallize technical- or battery-grade LiOH·H2O from a recovered lithium sulfate or carbonate feed.
output_forms: Lithium hydroxide monohydrate (LiOH·H2O), technical and battery grade
peg_li_hydroxide_bmed_recycle.qualification_criteria: Hydroxide converter (BMED or causticization) producing LiOH·H2O from a recovered lithium sulfate or carbonate feed.
peg_li_hydroxide_bmed_recycle.exclusion_criteria: Primary-feed causticization/EDBM hydroxide plants where the flowsheet is mineral/brine-specific; carbonate/LiCl converters.

peg_li_battery_smelter.definition: A high-temperature smelting facility that reduces battery feed to a Ni/Co/Cu alloy and a lithium-bearing slag, into which lithium reports. Materially distinct entity category from the mechanical black-mass plant; lithium exits in the slag rather than in black mass.
peg_li_battery_smelter.main_function: Smelt battery feed into a recoverable metal alloy and a lithium-bearing slag.
input_forms: Sorted spent batteries / scrap prepared as smelter feed
peg_li_battery_smelter.qualification_criteria: High-temperature smelter reducing battery feed to alloy plus a lithium-bearing slag.
peg_li_battery_smelter.exclusion_criteria: Mechanical black-mass plants; hydromet leach refineries; slag-leach lithium recovery plants.

peg_li_slag_leach_recovery.definition: A hydrometallurgical plant that leaches lithium-bearing smelter slag and recovers lithium as lithium carbonate via leaching, purification and crystallization. Distinct feed (slag) from the black-mass refinery but same lithium-chemical converter function; may be a separate facility from the smelter.
peg_li_slag_leach_recovery.main_function: Leach smelter slag and crystallize recovered lithium carbonate.
output_forms: Lithium carbonate (Li2CO3), technical and battery grade
peg_li_slag_leach_recovery.qualification_criteria: Hydromet plant that leaches lithium-bearing smelter slag and recovers Li2CO3.
peg_li_slag_leach_recovery.exclusion_criteria: Black-mass leach refineries (different feed); smelters; hydroxide/LiCl converters.

peg_li_integrated_clay_carbonate.definition: A combined upstream clay mining, beneficiation, leaching/roasting, purification and carbonate-precipitation chain represented as a single composite operation that yields lithium carbonate as the shared intermediate spine feeding downstream hydroxide or metal conversion.
peg_li_integrated_clay_carbonate.main_function: Produce lithium carbonate as the feed intermediate for causticization or chloride/metal conversion.

peg_li_integrated_clay_carbonate.qualification_criteria: Composite integrated clay operation delivering lithium carbonate as a shared intermediate spine.
peg_li_integrated_clay_carbonate.exclusion_criteria: Standalone constituent units where the flowsheet is enumerated stage-by-stage; brine/mineral integrated complexes.

routes.literal_route_note: Brine-to-metal route: brine -> concentration (solar evaporation OR DLE; shown here via evaporation+purification to a lithium chloride intermediate) -> production/purification of anhydrous LiCl -> molten-salt (LiCl-KCl eutectic, ~40/60, 420-550C) electrolysis in a Downs-type cell -> crude lithium metal -> refining/casting to ingot/foil/granular. Confidence medium per SB-04/EB-03 output-form-vs-child ambiguity and because most commercial Li metal is made from purified LiCl (which can originate from brine or from carbonate); the anhydrous-LiCl feed is commonly sourced by converting Li2CO3 with HCl, so a carbonate-derived LiCl sub-path is noted as an alternative feed.

Water leaching of roasted mass to dissolve lithium sulfate

Deep-discharge / de-energize cells to remove residual charge (fire/explosion safety-critical step)

Thermal pretreatment / pyrolysis (approx. 500-600 C) to deactivate cells and burn off binders, electrolyte and organic components (route variant; some flowsheets shred inert/wet without pyrolysis)
Sieving/classification to liberate fine electrode powder
Magnetic separation, density/air separation and screening to remove steel casings, aluminium and copper foils, and plastics
Recover fine metal-rich powder = black mass (Li, Ni, Co, Mn, Cu, graphite; metals largely as oxides)

major_groups.definition: A hard-rock LCT-pegmatite or lithium-mica mine with its co-located or associated beneficiation plant that mines run-of-mine ore and ships a lithium-mineral concentrate (spodumene, petalite, or lepidolite/zinnwaldite) off-site.

A lithium chemical conversion plant that receives spodumene concentrate and converts it to a purified lithium salt liquor via the sulfuric-acid roast-leach or soda-ash alkaline-autoclave route, including its internal solution-purification circuit.
A chemical plant that receives lithium-mica (lepidolite/zinnwaldite) concentrate and roast-leaches it with sulfate or lime-sulfate reagents to produce a lithium sulfate pregnant solution.
A closed-basin salar operation that extracts dissolved-lithium continental brine from an aquifer via a production well-field and delivers raw brine to concentration.
An engineered salar pond field (with associated softening) that concentrates raw brine by solar evaporation, precipitating bulk salts to yield a purified high-lithium liquor.

An engineered plant that selectively captures lithium from raw or pretreated brine using sorbent/ion-exchange/solvent-extraction media and delivers a purified, concentrated lithium chloride liquor via its integrated eluate concentration and softening steps.
A deep geothermal reservoir with its wellfield, co-located power plant, and brine-conditioning plant that produces and clarifies hot lithium-bearing brine for downstream lithium recovery.
A hydrocarbon-associated subsurface brine resource with its produced-water gathering and pretreatment facility that conditions co-produced formation brine to feed lithium recovery.

An integrated lithium-claystone operation spanning open-pit mining, beneficiation, acid-leach or salt-roast/water-leach, solid-liquid separation and purification, delivering a lithium liquor or carbonate as its shared intermediate.

An integrated Jadar-type lithium-borate operation spanning underground jadarite mining, HPGR beneficiation, sulphuric-acid digestion, boric-acid recovery and liquor purification with sodium-sulphate crystallisation to a purified lithium sulphate feed.
A standalone legacy lithium-bearing tailings or process-residue accumulation worked directly as a source, with on-site re-flotation or direct leaching to recover lithium.

The end-of-life battery recycling chain spanning spent-battery collection, mechanical black-mass production or pyrometallurgical smelting, and the hydrometallurgical refinery that leaches, separates metals and recovers/finishes recycled lithium salts and hydroxide.
A lithium carbonate conversion plant that purifies a lithium salt liquor and precipitates, refines, dries and packages battery- and technical-grade lithium carbonate.
A lithium hydroxide conversion plant that produces and crystallises LiOH·H2O from a lithium feed via lime/NaOH causticization or membrane/electrochemical splitting.
A molten-salt electrometallurgical works that prepares anhydrous lithium chloride feed and electrowins, refines and finishes metallic lithium.
